task: The evaluation on the NUAA test of the C5 comparison pre-registered in PR #34 (PROTOCOL.md §6, amended in PR #37): the evaluable new models of AttackNetV1, AttackNetV2_1 and AttackNetV2_2 of the six runs and the 48 C2 references (LivenessNet and ResNet-18, their test scores of the C2 evaluation 20261121-ARCHEVAL-332fbdf), with the definitions of PR A (pad_anet_definitions): primary analysis at patience 4 and threshold 0.5, descriptive conditions, rankings, denominators, descriptive comparison with ResNet-18, guardian per network
authorisation: PROTOCOL.md §11: the evaluation code and configuration are published, with the link on the C5 card, before the NUAA test of the new models is read; evaluate runs once, after the six runs and after this configuration records them
operations: after the six runs: copy_run_records.py --runs-root results/anetrun --conditions-dir <folder of the launch logs> copies the records of the runs into this package; make_config.py --runs-root results/anetrun records the last attempt of each run and stops if any other field differs from the reference configuration: that of the last commit (git show HEAD), or the file given with --reference (the configuration of the published head of this pull request, saved with git show <commit>:delivery/aneteval/pad_anet_eval.json); the comparison guarantees that only runs changed since the reference, not that the reference was published; commit; the completed configuration and package published (a commit of this pull request or a new pull request) and linked on the C5 card; only then check-inputs and evaluate, launched from a zsh with setopt nobgnice through delivery/aneteval/launch.zsh (ANETEVAL_LOG_DIR=<a folder outside the repository> [ANETEVAL_ATTEMPT=1] nohup zsh delivery/aneteval/launch.zsh check-inputs | evaluate > <a log file outside the repository> 2>&1 &), which writes a conditions file per command; the launch script stops without launching the command if it is not run from the root of the repository, if ANETEVAL_LOG_DIR is missing or inside the repository, if the command is neither check-inputs nor evaluate, if evaluate has no ANETEVAL_ATTEMPT, or if the conditions file of the same label already exists (exit 9); it also stops, with the reason in the conditions file, if its nice value is not 0, if pmset -g batt does not say AC Power (evaluate only), or if check-machine of the runs or check-inputs of the evaluation fails (exit 1); the launch script never passes --second-reading: a second reading, if ever needed, is launched by hand with --second-reading under after_stop; evaluate once; the config_sha256 and code_sha256 recorded by evaluate are those of the published files (PROTOCOL.md §11); one heavy process at a time

run_records.rule: as for C2 (delivery/pad-arch-eval/runs/): the published records of every attempt of the six runs and of every check-estimator of the runs root, status.json, run.log and public/ (nothing of restricted/), with conditions.txt, the conditions file written by delivery/anetrun/launch.zsh, copied unchanged by delivery/aneteval/copy_run_records.py; check-inputs and evaluate check them byte for byte against the runs root and scan them for text a publishable output must not hold (check-inputs and copy_run_records.py without the manifests: personal paths and texts, not subject or frame identifiers; evaluate with the manifests loaded; for run.log and public/ the scan repeats that of the runner, made with the real inputs)

attempt_rule: amended PROTOCOL.md §6 (k)/(n): for each of the six runs only the last attempt is evaluated, which must be PASS with phase 1 complete for the 12 positions; the configuration records its run id and the SHA-256 of its status.json and of its two SHA256SUMS, and evaluate checks that no later attempt exists in the runs root
after_stop: a choice of the author, as in C2: no automatic resume; an evaluation that stops keeps its folder and outcome; test_read_started is recorded in status.json (false at the start, rewritten true before the fold schema and any test frame); a new attempt after an attempt with test_read_started, or one left RUNNING, or with a non-empty restricted/, or an unreadable one, is a second reading of the test, refused unless --second-reading, given only after the outcome has been reported on the C5 card and recorded in status.json and in the results; after the reading of the test the restricted test scores already computed are kept, with their SHA256SUMS, also for FAIL and INCOMPLETE
dev_reproduction: before any test frame of the new models: each evaluable model reloaded (checkpoint SHA-256 checked) and checked against the registry, its dev scored in both BN states (the saved re-estimated statistics installed) and compared with the dev scores saved by the run (pad_arch_run.evaluator_agreement: tolerances of PR #27); one model out: MISMATCH, the test is not read
c2_reproduction: before any test frame of the new models: from the 48 C2 test score files (each equal to the anchored restricted SHA256SUMS of the C2 evaluation) the primary analysis (pad_arch_definitions.primary_analysis), the 8 conditions and units.csv of C2 are recomputed and compared for exact equality with results.json and units.csv of the C2 evaluation (+0.0998 [0.0256, 0.1632], 926 valid resamples); a difference: FAIL; after the analysis the descriptive comparison of LivenessNet with ResNet-18 must be the exact opposite of the C2 gaps and contrast
test: after every dev reproduction and a re-verification: test_read_started written to status.json; the fold schema; the frame identifiers of the 48 C2 files compared with the test keys of their fold; per fold the test frames assembled once and scored by its evaluable models in both BN states; the 48 C2 references are not re-evaluated (their saved test scores are used)
non_finite_test: PROTOCOL.md §6 (n): a model with non-finite test scores in either BN state is reported with the count of such frames; the evaluation stops before the primary analysis (outcome NON_FINITE_TEST, the restricted test scores kept in restricted/ with their SHA256SUMS, no public result); no model is excluded after its test scores are computed; a new attempt is a second reading (after_stop)
analysis: pad_anet_definitions.primary_analysis and descriptive_analysis on the units of the 8 conditions (the guardian inside: an AttackNet with fewer than 12 pairs evaluable in both BN states is 'not computed' with the reason of its not evaluable models)

cap.unit: hours of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)
cap.rule: a choice of the author: three times the evaluation hours of plan/run_plan.md of PR A (0.59 h), rounded up to a multiple of 0.5 h; checked before the dev reproduction of each model, before the test assembly of each fold, before the test scoring of each model and before the analysis; at the cap or by SIGUSR1: INCOMPLETE, no result

choices_of_the_author.thresholds_source: a choice of the author: the thresholds of the new models from their saved dev scores (pad_arch_eval.load_dev), as in C2
choices_of_the_author.c2_reproduction_gate: a choice of the author: the reproduction of C2 from the 48 files compared for exact equality before the test (c2_reproduction)
choices_of_the_author.c2_units_bytes: a choice of the author: the units.csv of C2 recomputed and compared byte for byte
choices_of_the_author.non_finite_test_outcome: a choice of the author: the outcome name NON_FINITE_TEST (exit code 6) for the stop of PROTOCOL.md §6 (n)
choices_of_the_author.reused_thresholds: a choice of the author: the thresholds of the 48 references from their C2 test score files (threshold_dev_eer of the file)
choices_of_the_author.units_order: a choice of the author: the units of each condition in (fold, seed) order, the order of C2 units
choices_of_the_author.cap: a choice of the author: the cap of evaluate (cap.rule)
choices_of_the_author.attempts: a choice of the author: --attempt N required, a new attempt in a new folder; the official output root results/aneteval
choices_of_the_author.outputs: a choice of the author: the names and columns of the outputs; table.csv: per network and BN state the mean over the units of the per-unit APCER, BPCER and ACER of the primary condition, with units and denominators
choices_of_the_author.runs_record: a choice of the author: the six runs recorded after the runs by make_config.py --runs-root (RUNS_PENDING before)
choices_of_the_author.second_reading: a choice of the author: the option --second-reading and its rule (after_stop)
choices_of_the_author.run_records: a choice of the author: the records of the runs published in this package, as for C2, with conditions.txt (run_records)
choices_of_the_author.launch_conditions: a choice of the author: the launch script delivery/aneteval/launch.zsh and its conditions file, as for the runs (operations)
choices_of_the_author.test_one_class: a choice of the author: the form of the count of PROTOCOL.md §6 (f) on the test: per network x patience x BN state x threshold, the models (units) deciding one class for every test frame, in results.json (test_one_class)

test_read: the NUAA test of the new models is read once, by evaluate, after every check that does not need it. check-inputs: this configuration; the PR A configuration and what it pins; the configuration of the runs (pad_anet_run.load_config and load_pins: the PR A package, the trial, the plan, the PR #27 and #28 configurations); the amended protocol of the PR B package; the public status.json, results.json and units.csv of the C2 evaluation 20261121-ARCHEVAL-332fbdf and its restricted SHA256SUMS with the 48 <p4|p12>_<network>_fold<k>_seed<s>_test_scores.csv it lists (the C2 test scores, already published as aggregates: read to reproduce C2 exactly); when the runs are recorded, their status.json, run.log, SHA256SUMS and the files they list. evaluate, in addition: what pad_arch_comparison.load_inputs reads (manifests, cache, extracted frames, cells and folds runs); the dev scores and BN statistics of each evaluable new model; its checkpoint; after the dev reproduction of every model, the fold schema and the test frames of each fold, assembled once
